kevin: Ran a focused nsys sweep on the latest attn-lane changes, looks like per-head lane divergence is killing SM packing. attaching top-line output, can folks eyeball hotspots?

kevin: command I used:
```
nsys profile -o attn_lane_probe --sample=cpu,osrt --trace=nvtx,cuda -t cuda,osrt -w true ./run_inference --model rdinf-attn-test --seq 1024 --batch 8
```

kevin: quick top kernels (from ncu/nvprof summary):
```
1) multi_head_attn_lane_fwd_v3          45.2%   320.1ms
2) matmul_8x32_TA                        18.7%   132.4ms
3) kv_cache_lookup_coalesce              9.3%    66.0ms
4) softmax_blocked_v2                    7.8%    55.2ms
5) ln_residual_merge                     6.1%    43.0ms
6) embed_remap_sparse                    4.5%    31.8ms
7) rng_fill_seq                          3.4%    23.9ms
```
